title: Edit your Business Profile - Google Business Profile Help

facts.fact: Businesses can select up to 9 more categories in addition to the primary category.
facts.quote: You can select up to 9 more categories.

facts.fact: Businesses can enter up to 2 more phone numbers in addition to the primary business phone number, and they cannot be fax numbers.
facts.quote: In addition to your primary business phone number, you can enter up to 2 more phone numbers. They can be mobile numbers or landline, but not fax.

facts.fact: Businesses can add one social media link per platform, for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, X, and YouTube.
facts.quote: You can add one social media link per platform to your Business Profile for:

facts.fact: Social media links are available only in select regions and may not be available for all users.
facts.quote: Social media links are currently available for select regions and may not be available for all users.

facts.fact: Chat options with text message or WhatsApp are available only in select regions, and only businesses with a claimed and verified Business Profile can add a WhatsApp or text messaging option.
facts.quote: Businesses with a claimed and verified Business Profile can add a WhatsApp or text messaging option.

facts.fact: A website URL entered on a Business Profile must be the full URL and include http:// or https://.
facts.quote: Enter the full URL, which includes “http://” or “https://.”

facts.fact: Businesses can hide their Business Profile phone number by turning on 'Don't show' under Advanced settings in Business Profile settings.
facts.quote: Under "Phone number,” turn on **Don't show.**

facts.fact: Google may occasionally contact the verified phone number on a profile using automated calls, texts, or WhatsApp messages to confirm business info, and this feature is available only for select regions, languages, and business categories.
facts.quote: Google may occasionally reach out using automated messages via call, text, or WhatsApp to the verified phone number on your profile.

facts.fact: Changing the business name after the profile is verified may require the business to verify again.
facts.quote: If you change your business name after it’s verified, you might need to verify your business again.

facts.fact: Deleting collected information removes it from Google's records but does not change other details already on the Business Profile.
facts.quote: Deleting collected information removes it from Google's records but does not change other details already on your Business Profile.

facts.fact: To edit business info, the user must sign in to the Google Account linked to the Business Profile.
facts.quote: To edit your business info, you need to sign in to the Google Account that's linked to your Business Profile.

facts.fact: The Google Business Profile description field must not exceed 750 characters.
facts.quote: Do not exceed 750 characters in the description field.

facts.fact: Business descriptions on Google Business Profile must not include URLs or HTML code.
facts.quote: Do not include URLs or HTML code.

facts.fact: For the opening date on a Google Business Profile, only the month and year need to be written.
facts.quote: You only need to write the month and year of your opening date.

facts.fact: A Google Business Profile opening date can be entered up to one year in the future, but it will not show on Google until 90 days before that date.
facts.quote: You can enter a date up to one year in the future, but it won't show up on Google until 90 days before the date.

facts.fact: The in-store products showcase on Google Business Profile is available to retail businesses in the US, CA, UK, and IE.
facts.quote: If you have a retail business in an eligible country (US, CA, UK, and IE)

facts.fact: To showcase in-store products on a Business Profile, a retailer must connect its Point of Sale system to the Local Inventory app.
facts.quote: you need to connect your store's Point of Sale system to the Local Inventory app.

facts.fact: Hotels can add check-in and check-out times to their Business Profile, and this feature is only available on a computer.
facts.quote: This feature is only available on a computer.

facts.fact: Responses to Business Profile attribute questions cannot be edited or deleted on mobile devices.
facts.quote: Responses to these attribute questions cannot be edited or deleted on mobile devices.

facts.fact: Google's car dealership inventory feature is a pilot available only for select business categories and regions.
facts.quote: This feature is available only for select business categories and regions.
